title: CriticJEPA: World Models Are Better Critics Than Optimizers
abstract: arXiv:2611.32357v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Visual world models enable goal-directed planning by predicting action outcomes. Gradient-based planners optimize actions to lower predicted goal cost, but continued optimization can exploit prediction errors after execution stops improving. Comparing plans requires informative relative scores; improving them also requires reliable update directions. Exact-state execution reveals that a frozen hierarchical world model ranks goal-conditioned proposals even when its rankings among outputs of prolonged gradient search are uninformative. Effective planning pairs goal-directed candidates with predictions that distinguish their outcomes. We introduce CriticJEPA, which learns goal-conditioned flow proposals from reward-free trajectories and uses frozen rollouts to select among them at every hierarchy level. translated_title: CriticJEPA：世界模型是比优化器更好的评判者
translated_abstract: 视觉世界模型通过预测动作结果来实现目标导向的规划。基于梯度的规划器通过优化动作来降低预测的目标代价，但当执行效果不再提升时，持续的优化可能会利用预测误差来“钻空子”。比较不同方案需要具有信息量的相对评分，而改进方案则需要可靠的更新方向。在精确状态下的执行实验表明，一个冻结的分层世界模型能够对目标条件下的候选方案进行有效排序，即使它在经过长时间梯度搜索得到的输出方案之间的排序是不具信息量的。有效的规划需要将目标导向的候选方案与能够区分其结果的预测相结合。我们提出了CriticJEPA，它从无奖励轨迹中学习目标条件的流（flow）候选方案，并在每个层级上使用冻结的模型推演（rollouts）来从中进行选择。前向选择构成了一个完整的规划器；在选择之前，短暂的锚定更新会对候选方案进行细化。在视觉导航与操作（manipul...）任务上……
tldr: 提出CriticJEPA，证明冻结的世界模型作为“评判者”比作为“优化器”更可靠，通过从无奖励轨迹学习目标条件的流候选方案，并在各层级用冻结模型推演进行前向选择，从而实现更稳健的视觉规划。
en_tdlr: CriticJEPA shows that frozen world models work better as critics than as optimizers: it learns goal-conditioned flow proposals from reward-free trajectories and selects among them via frozen rollouts at every hierarchy level, enabling more reliable visual planning.
